work_logs.title: Worked on Postgres version migration
work_logs.content_markdown: Standardized and executed the technical database migration strategy to seamlessly upgrade the core apicore production database from PostgreSQL 12 to 18.2. Performed a comprehensive application compatibility assessment across Rails 7.1 and runtime gems, evaluating zero-downtime cutover strategies, auth schema updates, and extension post-processing requirements. Authored the technical upgrade report and operational runbook, guiding the engineering team through staging validation and production cutover with zero application code changes required.

work_logs.content_markdown:

- Trace IDs are implemented for async endpoints
- Created a Cursor and Claude Code skill to query logs from Grafana.

work_logs.title: Created a visual separation between Admin dashboard of staging and production
work_logs.content_markdown:
- Previously, staging and production of the admin dashboard, where we manage critical data about the clients and other configurations, looked the same. It was hard for the developers to differentiate between the two.
- The developers mistakenly changed data in production. I was also on the verge of changing something, and I decided to solve the problem for good. I changed the color of the admin dashboard header, which gave the developers a clear visual difference.
work_logs.achievements: No change in production by mistake after that.

work_logs.title: Created an LLM Gateway to meter and monitor LLM usage inside Qburst
work_logs.content_markdown:
- I was the one and only developer on the project, which is used by more than 3000 employees in Qburst for accessing multiple LLM models.
- The project was created at the start of the GenAI wave and was able to work with raw LLM responses from all kinds of LLM providers, such as OpenAI, Gemini, Mistral, etc.
- The project is now deployed full organization wide and that's one of the best contributions I made to the company
